raw:
To activate your new card, please follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Open the app and log in to your account.
2. Go to the "Cards" section.
3. Select your new card and follow the on-screen instructions to activate it.

If you encounter any issues or need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or call our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for immediate help.

Yes, you can open an account for your children. Please visit a Chinor Bank branch or use the app to start the process. You will need to provide identification documents for both yourself and your children. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to ask!

Yes, you can open a bank account for your newborn baby at Chinor Bank. To do this, you will need to provide the necessary documentation, such as the baby's birth certificate and your identification. You can either visit a Chinor Bank branch or use the Chinor Bank app to initiate the account opening process. If you need further assistance, you can contact a human agent through the in-app chat or visit a branch during their operating hours.

Yes, you can use your Chinor Bank card at ATMs. Just insert your card, enter your PIN, and select the amount you want to withdraw. If you have any issues, you can contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance.

To find the nearest ATM, you can use the Chinor Bank app. Open the app, go to the "Services" section, and select "ATMs." The app will show you a list of nearby ATMs along with their locations and operating hours. If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support through the app or visit a branch during business hours.

I'm sorry, but I can't set up automatic money additions for your account. You can manage your account settings and set up automatic transfers through the Chinor Bank app. If you need further assistance, you can contact a human agent in the app or visit a branch during business hours.

I'm sorry to hear that you haven't seen the funds from your cheque yet. It can take a few days for the cheque to be processed and the funds to be credited to your account. If you're concerned, you can check the status of the cheque in the app or contact a human agent for assistance. How can I help you further?

I'm sorry to hear that you were unable to complete the transfer. Could you please provide me with more details about the issue you encountered? Was there an error message displayed, or did the transaction simply fail without any notification?

I'm sorry to hear that your transfer isn't going through. Could you please tell me the type of transfer you're trying to make (e.g., domestic, international, or within Chinor Bank)? This will help me provide more specific guidance.

I'm sorry to hear that. If you don't want the transaction to go through, you can cancel it in the app. If you need help with that, I can guide you through the steps. Would you like me to assist you with that?

I'm sorry to hear that. Unfortunately, I cannot reverse transactions directly. To initiate a refund or dispute, please follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app: [provide detailed steps]. If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer service team during business hours (08:00-22:00) for help.

To get a new card, the cost is 35,000 UZS, but the first replacement each year is free. The standard delivery takes 7 business days, and if you choose express delivery, it will take 2 days for an additional fee of 45,000 UZS.

You can use your Chinor Bank card at any merchant that accepts Visa or Mastercard, both in Uzbekistan and internationally. This includes shops, restaurants, online stores, and ATMs. For a list of specific locations, you can check the app or contact a human agent for more detailed information.

Yes, your Chinor Bank card is accepted worldwide wherever Visa is accepted. It works for both online and in-store purchases, as well as ATM withdrawals. If you have any specific concerns or need further assistance, feel free to ask!
You can expect to receive your new card within 7 business days for free delivery. If you need it sooner, you can opt for express delivery, which takes 2 days and costs 45,000 UZS.

I'm sorry to hear that you've found your lost or stolen card. Unfortunately, I cannot assist with linking a card to your account or verifying its status. For security reasons, please contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 to report the card and get further instructions. They can help you with the necessary steps to secure your account.

I'm sorry to hear that your card isn't working. To assist you better, could you please tell me if you're experiencing issues with making payments, withdrawing cash, or if the card is not being recognized at all?

I'm sorry to hear that your card isn't working. Could you please tell me if you're trying to use it for a contactless payment or a PIN-based transaction? Also, have you tried using the card in a different location or with a different device?

I'm sorry to hear that. If you suspect your card has been used fraudulently, please call the 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 immediately. They can help you secure your account and guide you through the next steps.

I'm sorry to hear that you're seeing an unfamiliar payment on your account. To help you better, could you please provide the date and amount of the payment? This will allow me to look into it more closely and assist you further.

I'm sorry to hear that. To resolve this, you can initiate a dispute through the Chinor Bank app. Please log in to your account, go to the "Transactions" section, find the transaction in question, and select "Dispute." Follow the prompts to provide details about the issue. If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer service team during business hours (08:00-22:00) for help.

I'm sorry to hear that. Could you please provide me with the details of the transaction, such as the date, amount, and the currency you were exchanging? This will help me better understand the situation and assist you accordingly.

The extra charge for the withdrawal could be due to a fee associated with the transaction or a service charge. To confirm the exact reason, please check your transaction details in the app or contact our customer support for more information.

Your account may have been charged for using an ATM due to a transaction fee or a withdrawal amount exceeding your account balance. To confirm the reason for the charge, please check your transaction history in the app or contact a human agent for assistance.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you please provide me with the date and time of the transaction? This will help me better understand the situation and assist you accordingly.

To change your PIN, you can do it through the Chinor Bank app. Here’s how:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app.
2. Go to the "Settings" or "Profile" section.
3. Look for the option to change your PIN.
4. Follow the prompts to set a new PIN.

If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or call the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for any issues related to your card.

I'm sorry, but I cannot assist with changing your PIN. For security reasons, you need to be in the country to update your PIN. Please contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance. They can guide you through the process.

I'm sorry to hear that. It's important to act quickly if you suspect unauthorized use of your card. Please call the 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 immediately to report the issue and get assistance. They can help you secure your account and guide you through the next steps.

Yes, you can get a card even if you're not in the UK. Chinor Bank offers international services, and you can apply for a card through our app. Just make sure you have a valid ID and a mobile number to complete the application process. If you need further assistance, you can reach out to our in-app human chat during our operating hours or call our card line for any urgent issues.

I'm sorry to hear that your card payment was declined. There could be several reasons for this, such as insufficient funds, a temporary hold on your account, or a security measure triggered by the bank. To get more specific information, you can check your account balance and recent transactions in the Chinor Bank app. If the issue persists, I recommend contacting our customer service team for further assistance. They can provide you with detailed information and help resolve the issue. Would you like me to guide you on how to reach them?

I'm sorry to hear that your card payment didn't work. Could you please provide me with more details about the transaction? For example, what was the amount, the merchant's name, and when did the transaction occur? This information will help me better understand the issue and assist you further.

Hello! I'm sorry to hear that your card withdrawal was declined. Could you please confirm if you have tried using the card for any other transactions recently? This might help us understand the issue better. If you need further assistance, you can contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for immediate support.

I'm sorry to hear that your cash withdrawal was declined. Could you please provide me with the date and time of the transaction, as well as the amount you were trying to withdraw? This information will help me better understand the situation and assist you accordingly.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your transfer. Could you please provide more details about the issue you're facing? For example, did the transfer fail, or are you unable to initiate it?

A virtual disposable card is useful for online purchases where you want to limit the amount of money that can be spent or for one-time transactions. It helps protect your main account from potential fraud. If you need more details or have any other questions, feel free to ask!

To update your address, you can do it directly in the Chinor Bank app. Here’s how:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app.
2. Go to the "Profile" or "Settings" section.
3. Select "Personal Information" or "Address."
4. Update your address and save the changes.

If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or visit a branch during business hours (Monday to Friday, 09:00-18:00).

To update your address, you can do it through the Chinor Bank app. Open the app, go to your profile, and select the option to update your personal information. If you need further assistance, you can contact our in-app human chat service, available daily from 08:00 to 22:00.

To exchange currencies, you will need to pay a fee of 1% of the transaction amount. This fee is applied to all currency exchanges, regardless of the amount. If you have any further questions or need assistance with the process, please let me know.
As an AI, I don't have real-time access to exchange rates. For the most accurate and up-to-date exchange rates, please check the Chinor Bank app or contact a human agent for assistance.
I don't have real-time exchange rates, but you can check them in the Chinor Bank app. If you need help, you can contact a human agent through the app's chat feature during business hours.

Chinor Bank supports the exchange of several major currencies, including USD, EUR, GBP, and RUB. For a complete list of supported currencies and current exchange rates, you can check the "Exchange Rates" section in the Chinor Bank app. If you need further assistance, feel free to ask!

Chinor Bank does not offer currency exchange services through the app. For currency exchange, you can visit a Chinor Bank branch or use a third-party service. If you need assistance with a specific transaction, feel free to ask!
I'm sorry to hear that you're seeing an unexpected fee on your statement. Could you please provide me with the date and amount of the fee so I can look into it for you?

I'm sorry to hear that you were charged an extra pound. To process a refund, please contact our customer service team through the in-app chat during our operating hours (08:00-22:00) or reach out to our 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance. They will guide you through the necessary steps to resolve this issue.

I'm sorry to hear that your transfer didn't work. Could you please provide me with the date and time of the transfer, as well as the amount and recipient's account number? This information will help me better understand the issue and provide you with a more accurate response.
Chinor Bank supports holding and exchanging in Uzbek Som (UZS) and US Dollars (USD). For more details, you can check the app or contact a human agent.

Disposable cards are one-time use cards that you can generate through the Chinor Bank app for secure online transactions. Each disposable card has its own unique number, expiration date, and CVV, which you can use for a single purchase. Once the transaction is completed, the card is automatically deactivated and cannot be used again. This helps protect your main card information and reduces the risk of fraud. To create a disposable card, open the app, go to the "Cards" section, and select "Generate Disposable Card."
No, your card PIN is not saved in the app for security reasons. If you need to change your PIN, you can do so through the app or by contacting our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble locating your card PIN. The PIN is usually sent to you separately from the card, often via a secure message or email. If you haven't received it, you can request a new PIN through the app or contact our customer service for assistance. Would you like me to guide you on how to do that?

To get a second card, you can request it through the Chinor Bank app. Go to the "Cards" section, select the card you want to add a second one to, and follow the instructions to request a duplicate. If you need further assistance, you can contact our in-app human chat during business hours or call the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for any urgent issues.

Yes, Chinor Bank offers virtual cards through its app. These virtual cards can be used for online transactions and provide an additional layer of security. To get a virtual card, you can follow these steps in the app:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app.
2. Navigate to the "Cards" section.
3. Select "Virtual Card."
4. Follow the prompts to create and activate your virtual card.

If you need further assistance or have any questions, feel free to ask!
If your card is missing, you should immediately contact the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22. They can help you with the necessary steps to secure your account and issue a replacement card.

I'm sorry to hear that. If you believe your phone is lost or stolen, it's important to act quickly to protect your account. First, please log in to the Chinor Bank app on another device to secure your account. If you're unable to do so, you can contact our 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance. They can help you freeze your card and guide you through the next steps.

If you lost your phone, someone could potentially access your account if they have your login credentials. To protect your account, immediately log in to the Chinor Bank app from another device and change your password. If you suspect unauthorized access, contact our 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance.

Your card will be delivered to the address you provided during the application process. You can track the delivery status in the Chinor Bank app under the "Cards" section. If you need further assistance, you can contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for any updates or issues.
I'm an AI assistant for Chinor Bank. I can't help you recover your app code. Please contact our in-app human chat for assistance. They're available daily from 08:00 to 22:00.

A pending payment means that a transaction has been initiated but is not yet complete. It is waiting for the recipient's bank to process and confirm the payment. This can take a few minutes to a few hours, depending on the banks involved. If the payment remains pending for an extended period, you may want to check with the recipient or contact our support team for further assistance.

Payment authorisation typically takes a few seconds to a few minutes, depending on the type of transaction and the security measures in place. If you're experiencing delays, please check your internet connection or try again later. For further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or call our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I'm sorry to hear that your ATM cash out is still pending. Could you please provide me with the transaction ID or reference number for the cash out so I can check the status for you?

I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing a delay with your top-up. Could you please provide me with the date and time when you initiated the top-up, as well as the amount you were trying to add? This information will help me better understand the situation and assist you more effectively.
I'm sorry to hear that your payment is still pending. Could you please provide me with the transaction ID or reference number so I can check the status for you?

If you've tried to enter your PIN too often, your card will be blocked for security reasons. To unblock it, you can contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22, which is available 24/7. They will guide you through the necessary steps to regain access to your account.

To deposit your salary into your Chinor Bank account, you can provide your employer with your account details, including your account number and the bank's SWIFT/BIC code. They can then transfer the funds directly to your account. If you need assistance with the process, you can contact your employer's HR or payroll department for guidance.

You do not need to configure anything for receiving your salary in GBP. Chinor Bank supports multiple currencies, and your salary will be credited to your account in GBP as usual. If you have any issues or need to check your account details, you can do so in the app or contact a human agent for assistance.

I'm sorry to hear that your refund isn't showing on your statement. Could you please provide me with the transaction ID or any other details about the refund you're referring to? This will help me assist you better.

If your card payment has been cancelled, it could be due to several reasons such as insufficient funds, a declined transaction, or a security issue. To resolve this, please check your account balance and ensure that your card is not blocked. If the issue persists, you can contact our customer support team for further assistance.

Your card payment may be reverted if there is a dispute, fraud, or if the transaction is declined due to insufficient funds or exceeding your spending limit. To check the status of a specific transaction or to initiate a dispute, you can review your transaction history in the app or contact a human agent for assistance.

I'm sorry, but I can't assist with adding money to your account using American Express. For account-related tasks, please use the Chinor Bank app or contact a human agent. Would you like assistance with something else?

Chinor Bank supports Mastercard and Visa credit cards. These cards can be used for both domestic and international transactions. If you need more details or have any specific questions about these cards, feel free to ask!

I'm sorry to hear that you want to delete your account. To proceed, please confirm if you have any outstanding balances or pending transactions that need to be resolved before we can proceed with the deletion. If you do, I can guide you on how to settle them. If not, I can assist you in initiating the account deletion process. Please let me know how you would like to proceed.

Yes, SWIFT transfers are supported by Chinor Bank. To initiate a SWIFT transfer, please follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Open the app and navigate to the "Transfers" section.
2. Select "International Transfer" or "SWIFT Transfer."
3. Enter the recipient's bank details, including the SWIFT/BIC code, account number, and any other required information.
4. Review the details and confirm the transfer.

If you need further assistance or have any questions, feel free to ask. For more detailed support, you can contact our in-app human chat during business hours (08:00-22:00) or reach out to our 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for urgent matters.

There is no fee for topping up your account using a card. However, if you're topping up from another bank's card, there might be a fee charged by that bank. For more details, you can check the specific terms of your card issuer or contact their customer service. If you need further assistance, feel free to ask!

You can add money using an international card, but there may be fees involved. The specific fees depend on the type of card and the currency you're using. For detailed information on fees, you can check the "Fees" section in the app or contact a human agent for assistance.

Chinor Bank does not offer deposit accounts. We focus on providing retail banking services through our app, including cards, transfers, and account management. For more information on our services, you can explore the app or contact our in-app human chat during business hours.

The app may have denied your top-up due to several reasons, such as exceeding your daily or monthly limit, insufficient funds in your account, or an issue with the payment method you used. To resolve this, please check your account balance and limits, and ensure that your payment method is valid and has sufficient funds. If the issue persists, you can contact our customer support team for further assistance.

You can top-up your account as much as you want, but there are limits on how much you can transfer in a day or week. To check your limits, you can look in the app under "Account Limits" or contact a human agent for more details.

A top-up might be reverted and returned to your account for several reasons, such as insufficient funds in the source account, an error in the transaction details, or if the transaction was flagged for security reasons. If you're unsure about the specific reason, I recommend checking your transaction history in the app or contacting a human agent for more detailed information.

To fix a reverted top up, please contact our customer support team through the in-app chat or call our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22. They will assist you with the necessary steps to resolve the issue.

I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble seeing your top-up in your wallet. Could you please provide me with the date and time of the top-up, as well as the amount you added? This will help me better understand the situation and assist you more effectively.

To top up your account, your friends can use the "Send Money" feature in the Chinor Bank app. They can select your account and enter the amount they wish to transfer. If they don't have the app, they can use the "Send Money" option in the app or visit a Chinor Bank branch to make the transfer.

I'm sorry to hear that you've been charged twice for the same transaction. Let's check the details of the transactions to understand what happened. Could you please provide me with the transaction IDs or the dates of the transactions? This will help us investigate further. If you need immediate assistance, you can also contact our customer service team for a more detailed investigation.

I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing issues with your transactions. Unfortunately, I cannot see your account or transactions, but I can guide you on how to resolve this. Please log into the Chinor Bank app, go to the "Transactions" section, and report the double charges. If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or call the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for immediate help.

No, there should not be a fee for the transfer you made. If you see a fee, it might be due to a specific condition or service. Please check the details of the transfer in the app or contact a human agent for more information.

I can't help with transfers from other banks directly. You can use the app to transfer money between your own accounts. For transfers from other banks, you'll need to contact your other bank or use a third-party service. If you need further assistance, you can reach out to a human agent in the app during our operating hours.

Yes, you can add funds to your Chinor Bank card directly from your bank account using the app. To do this, go to the "Add Funds" section in the app and follow the instructions to link your bank account and transfer the desired amount. If you need further assistance, you can contact our in-app human chat during business hours or call the card line for any urgent matters.

Money transfers within Uzbekistan typically take 1-2 business days to complete. For international transfers, the time can vary depending on the destination country and the specific bank involved, but it generally takes 3-5 business days. If you need more detailed information or have specific concerns, you can contact our customer service team through the app or call our 24-hour card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance.
I'm sorry to hear that your transfer hasn't gone through yet. Could you please provide me with the transaction ID or reference number so I can look into this for you?
Funds typically take 1-3 business days to appear in your account, depending on the type of transaction. For more specific details, you can check the app or contact a human agent for assistance.

To verify your identity, you can follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app and log in to your account.
2. Navigate to the "Settings" or "Profile" section.
3. Look for the "Identity Verification" or "Verify Identity" option.
4. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the verification process. This may include providing personal information, uploading identification documents, or completing a video call with a bank representative.

If you encounter any issues or have further questions, you can contact the in-app human chat support during their operating hours (08:00-22:00) or reach out to the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for assistance.

To complete the identity check, you can follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app and navigate to the "Profile" or "Settings" section.
2. Look for the "Identity Verification" or "KYC (Know Your Customer)" option.
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to upload the required documents, such as a government-issued ID (passport, national ID, or driver's license) and a selfie.
4. Submit the documents and wait for the verification process to be completed. This may take a few minutes to a few hours.

If you encounter any issues or have further questions, you can contact the in-app human chat support during their operating hours (08:00-22:00) or visit a branch during their business hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00).

To see your source of funds, you can check your transaction history in the Chinor Bank app. This will show you where your money is coming from and going to. If you need further assistance, you can contact a human agent through the in-app chat or visit a branch during business hours.

To verify your funds, you can check your account balance in the Chinor Bank app. If you need further assistance, you can contact our in-app human chat during business hours (08:00-22:00) or visit a branch from Monday to Friday between 09:00-18:00.

I'm an AI assistant for Chinor Bank. I can't see your account or provide verification codes. To find your verification code, please check the email or SMS you received when you ordered the top-up card. If you need further assistance, you can contact our customer support team through the app or visit a branch during business hours.

Virtual cards are not supported for subscription services. Please use your physical card for these transactions. If you need further assistance, you can contact our in-app human chat during business hours or call the card line for more information.

I'm sorry to hear that your disposable card isn't working. Could you please check if the card has been activated? If it's still not working, I recommend contacting our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for further assistance. They can help you with any issues related to your card.

I understand your concern about providing personal information. At Chinor Bank, we take your privacy seriously and only collect the necessary information to comply with legal and regulatory requirements. This helps us ensure the security of your account and prevent fraud. If you have any specific questions or need further clarification, feel free to ask, and I'll do my best to assist you.

I understand you have concerns about verifying your identity. However, verifying your identity is a necessary step to ensure the security of your account and protect your personal information. If you have any specific concerns or questions about the verification process, I can help clarify them for you. Would you like to discuss this further?

I'm sorry to hear that you didn't receive your cash back after withdrawing. Could you please provide me with more details about the transaction, such as the date and time of the withdrawal, the amount withdrawn, and any reference numbers or transaction IDs? This information will help me better understand the situation and assist you accordingly.
I'm sorry to hear that you didn't receive the full amount you requested. Could you please provide me with the transaction details or reference number so I can look into this for you?

I'm sorry to hear that the exchange rate for your cash withdrawal isn't as expected. Could you please provide more details about the transaction, such as the amount withdrawn and the currency involved? This will help me better understand the situation and assist you further.

I'm an AI assistant for Chinor Bank. I can help with questions about our app, cards, transfers, and more. For topping up Google Pay, you might need to check the Google Pay app or website for instructions. If you need help with something else related to Chinor Bank, feel free to ask!

Yes, you can use Google Pay to top up your Chinor Bank account. To do this, you need to have the Chinor Bank app installed on your device and be logged in. Then, open the Google Pay app, select the "Send & Request" option, choose "Send Money," and enter the recipient's phone number or email address associated with their Chinor Bank account. Enter the amount you wish to transfer and confirm the transaction. The funds will be transferred to the recipient's Chinor Bank account instantly. If you encounter any issues or have further questions, please contact our customer support team for assistance.

I'm an AI assistant for Chinor Bank. I can't see your account details or transactions. To check your balance transfer, please log in to the Chinor Bank app and review your transaction history. If you need further assistance, you can contact a human agent through the in-app chat during our operating hours, which are from 08:00 to 22:00 daily.

I'm sorry to hear that your bank transfer hasn't shown up yet. Could you please provide me with the date and time of the transfer, as well as the amount and the recipient's account number? This information will help me better understand the situation and assist you more effectively.

It's normal to wait up to 7 business days for your new card. If you need it sooner, you can opt for express delivery for 45,000 UZS, which takes 2 days. Would you like to proceed with express delivery?
I'm sorry to hear that your card hasn't arrived yet. Could you please provide me with your order number or the date you placed the order? This will help me check the status of your card delivery.

You might be charged a fee for card payment if you're using a card that isn't part of the Plus plan, which includes unlimited card payments for 25,000 UZS per month. If you're on a different plan or have exceeded your monthly limit, you may incur additional fees. To confirm your plan and any applicable fees, please check your account details in the app or contact a human agent for assistance.

To avoid fees on your Chinor Bank card, ensure you're within the free transaction limits and use the card within Uzbekistan. For international transactions, consider upgrading to the Plus plan for 25,000 UZS/month, which offers fee-free international usage. Always check the app for current fee details and limits.

If your card was "stolen" by an ATM, it's important to act quickly. First, contact the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 immediately to report the issue. They can help you secure your account and guide you through the next steps. If you need further assistance, you can also reach out to a human agent through the in-app chat during business hours (08:00-22:00) or visit a branch during their operating hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00).

I'm sorry, but I can't assist with retrieving an ATM card from a machine. For assistance with this, please contact the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22. They can help you with any issues related to your card.

I'm sorry to hear that your contactless payment isn't working. Could you please check if your card is within the 900,000 UZS limit per tap and if you're holding the card close enough to the terminal? If the issue persists, I recommend contacting the card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for further assistance.

I'm sorry to hear that your contactless payment isn't working. Let's check a few things. Have you tried using a different card or a different payment method? If the issue persists, it might be a good idea to contact our card line at +998 (71) 000-11-22 for further assistance. They can help you troubleshoot the issue or arrange for a replacement card if necessary.

I'm sorry to hear that you're seeing a direct debit payment on your app that you didn't make. This could be due to a few reasons, such as a mistake by the merchant, a fraudulent transaction, or an error in your account. To investigate this further, I recommend reaching out to our customer support team through the in-app chat, which is available daily from 08:00 to 22:00. They will be able to assist you in resolving this issue and ensuring the security of your account.

I'm sorry to hear that. To dispute a direct debit, you can follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Go to the "Transactions" section.
2. Find the specific transaction you want to dispute.
3. Tap on the transaction to view more details.
4. Select the "Dispute" option.
5. Follow the prompts to provide the necessary information and submit your dispute.

If you need further assistance or have any questions, feel free to ask!

To apply for a refund, you can follow these steps in the Chinor Bank app:

1. Open the Chinor Bank app and log in to your account.
2. Navigate to the "Transactions" or "Payments" section.
3. Find the transaction you want to dispute and select it.
